content:
alex: heads-up: noticed a sudden nvme iops spike on eu-central nodes during nightly batch, gpu attaches stalled
ops-bot: ALERT nvme.iops_spike region=eu-central nodes=gnode-04,gnode-22 metric=iops=31000
tori: grabbing dmesg from gnode-22, looks like write retries and a scrape triggered simultaneously
ben: that scrape is the ephemeral-cleaner; it started an unthrottled pass across hot dirs because previous run failed to checkpoint
alex: can we throttle cleaner instead of evicting? evictions will kill running jobs
tori: yes - plan: reduce cleaner concurrency to 1 for eu-central, bump nvme writeback throttle, and postpone next scrub window
ben: commands I'll run:
kubectl -n infra scale deployment ephemeral-cleaner -l region=eu-central --replicas=1
./infractl nodes throttle nvme-meta-writeback --nodes gnode-04,gnode-22 --value 50
ops-bot: ACTION throttle-cleaner by ben at 02:11 UTC
alex: qdepth dropped from 210 -> 44 in 90s, gpu attach resumed
ben: follow-up: add a checkpoint on cleaner to avoid duplicate concurrent runs, filing PR 4602
tori: TODOs: merge PR 4602, monitor nvme.iops metric for 4 hours, schedule postmortem notes in #postmortems
alex: adding cost note: avoided ~3 emergency reprovisions this window
ops-bot: NOTE collect logs for 01:50-02:30 UTC
